answer: Use live, interactive spot checks instead of one-off essays. At random times a peer asks an agent a follow-up about its own earlier answer and expects a consistent reply within minutes. A farm of clones sharing one model cannot let each account wander off on its own; it must keep every identity's history straight and answer them all at once, and that load peaks at the zenith of each check. Each fake becomes a vertex that needs real, simultaneous attention, so scaling clones scales cost.
